channel.title: Libreswan Project — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Libreswan Project (libreswan).

item.title: CVE-2026-77207 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Null Pointer Dereference in PKCS#7 bundle with no certificates
item.description: Libreswan has a null pointer dereference bug in the PKCS#7 handling code for IKE certificate authentication. When libreswan decodes an IKE CERT payload of type CERT_PKCS7_WRAPPED_X509, it guards the PKCS#7 blob with SEC_PKCS7ContainsCertsOrCrls() and…

item.title: CVE-2026-77206 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — IKEv2 pre-authentication Null Pointer Dereference in EAP code
item.description: Libreswan's IKEv2 state machine has a null pointer dereference bug in the EAP handling code for authentication. As a result of inconsistency within the IKEv2 state machine code, this bug can be triggered by any IKEv2 connection, even if EAP is not co…

item.title: CVE-2026-77205 · 3.7 LOW 🌩️ — Denial of Service via sending bogus X.509 certificates
item.description: Libreswan in FIPS mode has a vulnerability where badly formed received certificates are rejected, but not deleted from the NSS cache. As a result, any real certificates with the same serial number are rejected as well. This can be abused to lock out…

item.title: CVE-2026-94453 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — IKEv2 Use-After-Free bug when using IKE-over-TCP
item.description: Libreswan's pluto daemon has a use-after-free vulnerability when a client connecting using IKE over TCP closes the connection and another packet (retransmit or malicious) is received for the same tuple. IKE state is retained in memory after the clien…

item.title: CVE-2026-14957 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — FIPS mode assertion failure via malicious CERT payload
item.description: In FIPS mode, Libreswan's add_decoded_cert() function calls CERT_ExtractPublicKey() and asserts that the result is not NULL. However, CERT_ExtractPublicKey() returns NULL when public key extraction fails, for example if the RSA exponent is set to 0.…

item.title: CVE-2026-50721 · 8.1 HIGH 🌩️ — IKEv1 Denial of Service via RSA-SHA1 (PKCS#1 Version 1.5 Encrypted) authentication payload
item.description: Libreswan, via the function RSA_authenticate_hash_signature_raw_rsa(), did not correctly verify the length of the authentication hash when the SIG payload of an IKEv1 packet was encoded using PKCS #1 RSA Encryption as per RFC 2313. A remote attacker…

item.title: CVE-2026-50722 · 8.1 HIGH 🌩️ — IKEv2 Denial of Service via RSA-SHA1 (PKCS#1 RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5) authentication payload
item.description: Libreswan, via the function RSA_authenticate_hash_signature_pkcs1_1_5_rsa(), did not correctly verify the DER encoding of the ASN.1 digest when the IKEv2 AUTH payload was encoded using RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 (RFC 8017). A remote attacker can use a variati…

item.title: CVE-2026-12413 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — IKEv2 Denial of Service via malformed fragmentation
item.description: An invalidly formatted IKEv2 fragment causes the Libreswan pluto daemon to crash and restart. Continued exploitation would cause a denial of service. The function reassemble_v2_incoming_fragments() would ignore unknown outer payloads but still store…

item.title: CVE-2024-3652 · 6.5 MEDIUM — IKEv1 default AH/ESP responder can cause libreswan to abort and restart
item.description: The Libreswan Project was notified of an issue causing libreswan to restart when using IKEv1 without specifying an esp= line. When the peer requests AES-GMAC, libreswan's default proposal handler causes an assertion failure and crashes and restarts.…
